comparator.name: Data Science for Global Challenges
comparator.academicYear: Current 2026–2027 programme and published cohort course schemes, checked 2026-09-28
comparator.sourceNotes: The official programme is a three-year, 180-EC bachelor offered in parallel English and Dutch tracks. The normalized registry target records Dutch, but the current public programme explicitly permits either full-programme language track; the English track is selected to align the comparison language without changing academic content. The published schemes define 60 EC per year: a first-year foundation in life sciences, mathematics, statistics, computing and integrated projects; advanced data science, machine learning and responsible AI in year 2; and 30 EC free choice plus a 30-EC final-project cluster in year 3.
components: Introduction to Data Science for Global Challenges
Genuine elective semester; no optional package is invented.
BSc Thesis Data Science for Global Challenges
Preparation Data Science for Global Challenges Project
Integrative final project applying data science to a global challenge.

core: Programming, computer science, algorithms and data management
Mathematics, statistics, modelling, machine learning and AI
Integration of data science with life-science and global-challenge research
adjacent: Food security, agriculture, consumer systems and sustainable innovation
Climate, environment, sensors, satellite imagery and spatial evidence
Human health, physiology, epidemiology and disease prediction
Responsible AI, ethics and societal consequences of data systems
Large-scale, visual and heterogeneous data analysis
Scientific communication, interdisciplinary collaboration and applied research
questions: How can data science and AI help address climate change, health and food security?
How can complex life-science data be converted into reliable and actionable insight?
How should AI and data-intensive research be designed and applied responsibly?

alternatives.label: Data science, AI & global challenges
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum supplies the strongest available programming, algorithms, data science, machine-learning, AI, mathematics and applied interdisciplinary foundation.
alternatives.concept: The closest feasible UCR response: a technically deep data-science and AI curriculum designed for interdisciplinary application to scientific and societal challenges.
progression: Programming, data, mathematics and introductory AI precede algorithms, systems, machine learning, computer vision, deep learning, autonomous systems and advanced statistical modelling. Formal prerequisites and planned offerings pass; eight 300-level courses are included.
alternatives.distinctness: This programme replaces the business alternative’s economics, finance, marketing, leadership and organisational strategy sequence with sustained programming, algorithms, machine learning, neural networks, robotics, optimisation and mathematics, changing well over 30 EC.

alternatives.label: Climate, environment & responsible data
alternatives.labelReason: This pathway connects quantitative and computational literacy with sustainability, environmental evidence, governance, communication and responsible societal application.
alternatives.concept: A global-challenges direction for using data and responsible digital methods in climate, environmental and sustainability contexts.
progression: Sustainability, programming, communication and social-science foundations precede data science, responsible governance, machine learning and advanced interdisciplinary research. Formal prerequisites and planned offerings pass; six 300-level courses are included.
alternatives.distinctness: This programme replaces the closest programme’s sustained algorithms, autonomous-systems and advanced-computing sequence with environment, sustainability, communication, governance and interdisciplinary social-science study, changing well over 30 EC.

alternatives.label: Food, health & life-science data innovation
alternatives.labelReason: This pathway combines data foundations with economics, enterprise, organisations and innovation relevant to data-driven food, agriculture and health solutions.
alternatives.concept: An applied direction for translating data science into responsible food-system, agricultural, health and life-science innovation.
progression: Programming, data, business and economic foundations precede machine learning, organisational analysis, entrepreneurship and advanced data-informed strategy and innovation. Formal prerequisites and planned offerings pass; seven 300-level courses are included.
alternatives.distinctness: This programme replaces the climate-and-society alternative’s sustainability, politics, history, psychology and media sequence with sustained enterprise, economics, organisations, leadership and data-informed innovation study, changing well over 30 EC.

selection.assessment: The closest programme covers the defining data-science, AI and interdisciplinary identity. Climate/environment/responsible data and food/health/life-science innovation are independently evidenced, coherent and distinct. All three are mechanically feasible; production stops at the maximum.

notes.text: WUR prescribes dedicated life-science integration, domain projects, responsible AI and a 30-EC final challenge-project cluster. UCR can construct strong computational, environmental and innovation pathways, but it does not reproduce that fixed domain-integrated sequence. The alternatives are defensible liberal-arts data-science pathways, not structural equivalence.
